title: Unstack the crates
prompt: Take crates off the pile one at a time, printing each, until the pile is empty. The last one added comes off first.

docs.name: while condition:
docs.what: Repeats the indented lines as long as the condition stays true.

docs.name: list.pop_back()
docs.what: Removes the last item and returns it.

docs.name: list.is_empty()
docs.what: Returns true when the array has no items.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
